item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - HELP Mariah Carey - We Belong Together Music STATION 1440x1080 MPEG2
item.description:
Hi everyone,
I’m trying to obtain the original file:

Mariah Carey – We Belong Together (2005-04-01 Music Station 1440x1080 MPEG2)

The Bilibili user who owns it mainly collects HDTV-TS (original transport streams) and focuses heavily on Japanese and Chinese artists, followed by Korean, European and American performers.
He already has all the Mariah Carey material I offered, so I’m looking for rare HD broadcast recordings that could interest him for a fair trade.

Ideally:

  • Original HDTV-TS (no re-encode)

  • MPEG2 transport stream

  • Japanese TV performances (Music Station, Kouhaku, FNS, etc.)

  • Rare HD material from Asian artists
If anyone has something valuable that could help secure this trade, I would be extremely grateful and willing to collaborate.
My goal is simply to negotiate fairly and finally obtain the original “We Belong Together” Music Station file.
Please let me know if you’re interested.

Thank you very much!
